fact: Zambia Monitor reports the Zambia Bureau of Standards (ZABS), described as a national standards body, signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Rwanda Standards Board on standardisation, conformity assessment and quality assurance at the 32nd ARSO General Assembly in Mombasa; the report names no IT or data standard and does not say how ZABS was established.

ZABS states on its own site that it develops, publishes, maintains or withdraws Zambian National Standards, has developed standards in sectors including Information Communication Technology, and counts 6,500+ Zambian National Standards and 50+ international standards adopted as ZS; the page has no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used.
